Pi: source network layers/units and synapse-local tagged versus untagged loci are individuated without positing a new executive boundary
C: plasticity is admissible only through source-defined local activity/tag and neuromodulatory gating conditions; generic task condition is not automatically C
Q: RPE delta orients sign/strength of plasticity
P_out: selected response; selected action also participates in the source feedback pathway
K: global RPE interacts with tagged synapses to update weights
T: stimulus -> response selection -> feedback/tag formation -> delayed reward/RPE -> plasticity; trace/tag decay and trial reset ordering
rho/O: selected actions, network activity/working-memory readouts and task performance

L_ctx: Source task/experimental conditions remain explicit and are not retyped into C solely because they are called conditions.
L_claim: Negative, null, approximation, genealogy and epistemic qualifications remain claim-layer assertions rather than added system roles.
L_formal: Algorithmic inference/search/fitting carriers are kept distinct from source-supported cognitive state; formal plumbing cannot create a coordinator.

system_world_experiment.system: association/memory/action network, Q values, traces/tags, weights, source feedback and RPE-gated plasticity
system_world_experiment.boundary: stimuli/rewards enter P_in and actions leave P_out; global neuromodulator is internal source coupling, not a generic World controller

source_defined_coordination_or_gating: global neuromodulatory/RPE signal gates plasticity of tagged synapses
